outcome: A sorcery card can be cast only from hand in a main phase of its owner's turn with an empty stack.
A resolving sorcery follows its text and then goes to its owner's graveyard.
A sorcery that would enter the battlefield stays in its previous zone.
An only-as-a-sorcery action is legal exactly when the player has priority in their own main phase with an empty stack, whether or not sorcery casting is prohibited.
A check for a spell cast when a sorcery could not have been cast is true if it was cast without priority, outside its controller's main phase or with a nonempty stack.
note: Needs the cast timing on the spell.
